fields.label: Product Type
fields.description: Choose Variable if your product has multiple attributes - like sizes, colors, quality etc

fields.label: Downloadable
fields.tooltip: Downloadable products give access to a file upon purchase.

fields.label: Virtual
fields.tooltip: Virtual products are intangible and are not shipped.

fields.label: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)
fields.description: SKU refers to a Stock-keeping unit, a unique identifier for each distinct product and service that can be purchased.

fields.label: GTIN, UPC, EAN, or ISBN (Product Identifiers)
fields.tooltip: Enter a barcode or any other identifier unique to this product. It can help you list this product on other channels or marketplaces.

fields.label: Stock Status
fields.description: Controls whether or not the product is listed as "in stock" or "out of stock" on the frontend.

fields.label: Stock quantity
fields.description: Stock quantity. If this is a variable product this value will be used to control stock for all variations, unless you define stock at variation level.

fields.label: Low stock threshold
fields.description: When product stock reaches this amount you will be notified by email. It is possible to define different values for each variation individually.

fields.label: Allow Backorders
fields.description: If managing stock, this controls whether or not backorders are allowed. If enabled, stock quantity can go below 0.

fields.label: Allow only one quantity of this product to be bought in a single order.
fields.tooltip: Check to let customers to purchase only 1 item in a single order. This is particularly useful for items that have limited quantity, for example art or handmade goods.

fields.label: Downloadable Files
fields.description: Upload files that customers can download after purchase.

fields.label: Download Expiry
fields.description: Enter the number of days before a download link expires, or leave blank.

fields.label: Purchase Note
fields.description: Customer will get this in order email.

sections.label: Attributes
sections.description: Manage attributes and variations for this variable product.

sections.label: Shipping and Tax
sections.description: Manage shipping and tax for this product

fields.label: Override your store's default shipping cost for this product

sections.label: Linked Products
sections.description: Set your linked products for upsell and cross-sells

sections.label: Discount Options
sections.description: Set your discount for this product
